Create a new review (user or listing)

Create a new review for a user or listing, specifying context, metrics, and other details.

jwtAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required
booking_id
required
string

Associated booking ID (server will use this to infer author/target/context)

type
required
string
Enum: "user" "listing"

Type of entity being reviewed (guest_to_host is represented by 'user', guest_to_listing by 'listing')

comment
string <= 1000 characters

Optional textual comment for the review

emoji_sentiment
string
Enum: "👍" "👍👍" "👎"

Optional emoji sentiment for the review

required
